image_description: A large, dark blue and gold blimp (non-rigid airship) grounded on a grassy field. The envelope features prominent yellow text '00' and other graphics. A white gondola is suspended beneath the forward section. Several people are standing near the gondola and tail, providing scale. Ground support equipment, including a crane and tents, is visible in the background.
